Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Vintage Rustic Farmhouse Galvanized Metal Milk Jug Home Decor Planter Vase - 12.75 Inches, Grey
Colors: Gray
Materials: Stone
Bring a rustic vibe to your home with this galvanized metal planter resembling a vintage milk jug. Round wooden handles add a charming touch to this piece, which can be used as a planter or for cut flowers. It's ideal for antique or farmhouse décor. 7.5"D x 9"W x 12.75"H Can be used as a planter or as a vase for cut flowers; no drainage holes Galvanized metal and birch wood handles Intended for indoor use; metal will rust over time if exposed to rain outdoors
